name: canvas-room

description.en: The room/kitchen board drawn on ONE <canvas> by Rust (crates/dowiz-canvas, Wave CV row CV1) at /room/canvas/, beside the old room page. With the room's own session it reads the pass (GET /api/staff/kitchen) and the floor (GET /api/staff/room), listens on /api/live, and a tap on a ticket's bump button sends the console's own action (POST /api/owner/orders/:id/action). The page body holds exactly one element at rest; the site's CSP lets it compile the wasm. CV1b (W-CV1B): a tap on an open table opens its TABLE SHEET on the same canvas -- its rounds, lines, money and the old room page's actions (amend, pay, move lines, move the sitting, guest confirm/reject, add from the menu) through the same routes and room/net.js write path -- and a theme button stores dw_room_theme (as the phone / dark / light); the body still holds one element.
description.uk: Дошка зали й кухні, намальована Rust на одному <canvas> за адресою /room/canvas/: ті самі дані й дії, що й у персоналу; у body рівно один елемент. CV1b: дотик до столу відкриває його картку на тому ж canvas (раунди, позиції, оплата, дії старої сторінки), кнопка теми зберігає dw_room_theme; у body і далі один елемент.

producer.what: onIntent kind 1 (bump): POST /api/owner/orders/:id/action {location_id, action}; the intent comes from crates/dowiz-canvas/src/board/mod.rs Board::tap (Act::Bump)

consumer.what: owner::order_action (lib.rs POST /api/owner/orders/:id/action), Staff(&PASS) door, the kernel FSM decides the edge

readback.what: kitchen_orders(): GET /api/staff/kitchen -- the board's own read shows the ticket in its new status

sheet: GET /api/owner/settings (the pass reads notify.order.late_min; access.rs KITCHEN_READS)

external_note: No external API. The page is static assets (index.html, loader.js, board.js, feed.js, board.wasm) served by the edge under workers/api/public/_headers; its CSP must carry script-src 'wasm-unsafe-eval'.

auth.how: the owner's token signs the room session (staff_at accepts an owner for Cap::Advance and Cap::TakeOrders), exactly as feature-offline-sale does

probe: tools/live-proof/probes/feature-canvas-room.mjs: place a TEST order; open /room/canvas/ signed in with the owner token; body has 1 element; the page's CSP and the wasm's content-type; find the TEST ticket's Accept button in the scene (bump_rect), click it with a real mouse; GET /api/staff/kitchen and the owner's order show CONFIRMED; body still 1 element; close the order. CV1b: place a dine_in TEST round at a LIVE- table with the owner's room token; GET /api/staff/room has its sitting; click the Tables tab and that table's card (table_rect); the sheet opens (stats rows > 0, no refused row, no control under 44 px, anchors nav.back + round.pay), body still 1 element; click hud.theme: dw_room_theme = dark, the frame hash moved, body 1; close both orders.

producer_sheet.what: rows() (line 19): the sheet rows from room/logic.js rules; act() (line 178): each tapped row's request through room/net.js write (Idempotency-Key, outbox)

consumer_sheet.what: TSheet::apply reads the rows; draw lays them out and registers each control (Act::Sheet) for the hit-test and the learn anchors
